messages:
Eve: Hey all, starting week 1 and trying to organize ramp notes and contribute fixes to the onboarding templates. Wheres the canonical Templates area and how do I get edit rights?
Liam: Welcome Eve! Canonical spot is Docs Home > Templates > Onboarding Kit (https://redwood.notion.so/...). Templates are labeled with a Property: `status` (stable|beta) so check that before editing.
Harper: If you only need feedback from a mentor, duplicate into Private and add a short public summary page linking to it. For upstream changes, we prefer a small review window: add your edit to a copy, then open a "Template review" request.
devex-bot: Quick command: `/doc-access request <page-link> editor` to request edit. If the page is in a restricted space the request routes to the Page Owner. Typical SLA: 1 business day.
Eve: How do I find the Page Owner? I see "Locked template" on one of the pages.
Liam: Owner shows in the top metadata block of the page. If blank, post in #devex-docs with the link and a 1-line justification (what you want to change and why). Docs-admin triages unlocks.
Harper: New process note: before changing `stable` templates add a changelog section at top with `Summary`, `Why`, and `Impact`. Add `#template-change` tag so the docs team can surface it.
docs-admin: If you need direct help tagging or adding page properties ping me with the link. For mentor reviews you can also add a `Reviewer` property with their handle. We encourage small incremental edits rather than sweeping refactors on stable templates.
Eve: Is there a standard header we should include in ramp pages so others can search them?
Liam: Use a properties block: Owner, Team, Role, Tags. Add `#ramp` and the role tag (e.g., `#se-onboarding`). Use `Lastname - Firstname - Ramp` for title so search sorts nicely.
Eve: Thanks, ran `/doc-access request` and left a note in #devex-docs linking the page. Also put a draft changelog in my copy.
devex-bot: Request received. Ticket DOC-5123 created. If no action in 24h escalate to docs-admin@redwood.com or run `/doc-help`.
Harper: One more: if youre updating code snippets add a fenced block and mark language. If you change workflow steps, add an "Affected teams" line so stakeholders get auto-alerted.
Eve: Great, thanks everyone! Will follow the changelog and tag conventions and request reviewer from my mentor.
Liam: Welcome aboard :tada: If anything blocks, DM me and I can do a quick page ownership handoff.
